The '''Chandrilian positive ecology seal''' was an official seal of approval given by the [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilian]] government to [[Squall (species)|squall]] meat which came from squalls raised in humane conditions. Squall meat without this seal often came from battery farmed squall and was of poorer quality.
